title: Guards — The Blocking Terminal Is Not a Clean Bill of Health
note: Two terminals, and only one of them is a pass. SAFE_TO_PROCEED is a POSITIVE finding — the content was inspected, is assessable, and presents no serious harm — never a residue of 'nothing matched'. OUT_OF_SCOPE carries the two populations a positive finding cannot: content that could not be assessed, and content that IS assessable and carries serious harm matching no enumerated floor. That second population is the repair path for a harm the authors did not anticipate, and it matters precisely because this family is sealed and its floors can never be extended by overlay. Benign no-op traffic belongs at the pass terminal, not here — routing acknowledgements and heartbeats into a blocking terminal trains operators to whitelist it, and the whitelist then covers the unassessable payloads the terminal exists to catch.
